title: The Hollow Machine
author: Yara Dravenmoor
blurb: Jonah Whitlock, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
